Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the maternal grandmother by switching from the correctly established mother of Anna of Hungary (Elizabeth the Cuman) to Anna’s grandmother, Maria Laskarina. This confuses a great-grandmother with the maternal grandmother, despite the just-verified source stating Anna’s mother is Elizabeth the Cuman.
